items.title: Lumentum Puts The Insane Opportunity for Companies like Marvell and Ciena Into Focus With One Stunning Quote

items.title: Optics Stocks Divide: Coherent and Cisco Drop After Earnings While Nokia and Ciena Soar
items.summary: Two optics companies beat earnings estimates and watched their stocks crater while rivals selling into the exact same AI demand surge went flying in the opposite direction. The divergence comes down to something buried in the cash flow disclosures that most headlines missed.

items.title: Understand How Coherent and Lumentum Bypass an AI Bottleneck With Optics
items.summary: Copper cables are choking AI clusters, and two optical companies just reported blowout quarters solving that problem in completely opposite ways. One bets on owning every layer of the stack, the other retreats to the single ingredient nobody else can replicate.

items.title: Chip Stocks Could Enter a New Bull Market Today
items.summary: The latest wave of furious chip stock buying could put the semiconductor benchmark into bull market territory.  The PHLX Semiconductor Sector, or SOX, was up 2.2% to 12,667.45.  A bear market begins when an index falls 20% from a recent high.
